expected.question_text: An 8-month-old female is brought to the primary care physician by her father with a complaint of a delay in milestones. She is able to roll over, but has not yet sat up on her own. She was adopted from Africa six months ago. Physical examination reveals a moldy smell on the child. Laboratory studies reveal: | Phenylalanine level | 18 mg/dL | 1 mg/dL | |---|---|---| | Plasma tyrosine | 0.5 mg/dL | 1 mg/dL | Which of the following is the best treatment for this patient?
expected.explanation_header: The correct answer is Decreasing phenylalanine intake.
